about: Every case the e2e suite grades. real: true = recorded from a real repo or a live site by `node e2e/record.mjs` (source pinned to a commit or a URL and a date). real: false = no real example of that grade exists yet; the case is made up and says why. e2e/cases.json is what record.mjs wrote: do not edit it by hand.
